name: Aurelune: Seven Eclipses
summary:
The world's crystals are going out, one by one. In the shadows, someone thinks that's absolutely brilliant.

The Heart of Lumenvale feeds every crystal in Aurelune, and it is fading. To rekindle it, you set out to wake the four great crystals. On the way: a runaway samurai prince who would rather not be recognized, a Guardian who knows him better than she lets on, an airship crew that never stopped looking for him... and seven Eclipses who want the night to last forever. Aurelune: Seven Eclipses is a JRPG in the spirit of the 16-bit classics, made with RPG Maker MZ.
